data.summary: The figures match Microsoft's reported FY2023 results. Revenue was $211.9B, up from $198.3B (+6.9%). Net income was $72.4B against $72.7B, down 0.5% using the unrounded $72,361M and $72,738M. Operating cash flow was $87.6B against $89.0B. Cash and equivalents were $34.7B against $13.9B. Total assets were $412.0B against $364.8B, and total liabilities were $205.8B against $198.3B. The note about the 0.5% is correct: the rounded figures give about 0.4%, and the unrounded ones give about 0.52%. One caveat on interpretation: operating income actually rose about 6%, so the small drop in net income came more from items below operating income than from cost growth.
